# 2.2.4 Float

> Source: [MS-RDL] v20251031 — pages PDF 74–74.
> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

2.2.4 Float
If the RDL format specifies an element or attribute as type Float, it MUST be a valid IEEE single-
precision 32-bit floating point type [IEEE754], as specified in [XMLSCHEMA2] section 3.2.4 for
xsd:float.
